description: Defines the QuicChaosProtector class responsible for chaos protection in QUIC protocol, including methods for building data packets with padding, splitting crypto frames, adding ping frames, reordering frames, and serializing frames. It is part of the quic namespace and interacts with various QUIC core components.

classes.name: QuicChaosProtector
classes.description: Class responsible for chaos protection in QUIC, capable of constructing data packets with padding, splitting crypto frames, adding ping frames, reordering frames, and serializing frames for network transmission.

methods.name: QuicChaosProtector
methods.description: Constructor initializing the chaos protector with a crypto frame, padding, packet size, framer, and random generator.

methods.name: BuildDataPacket
methods.description: Attempts to build a chaos-protected data packet, returning its size or nullopt on error.

methods.name: WriteStreamData
methods.description: Writes stream data to the provided writer.

methods.name: WriteCryptoData
methods.description: Writes crypto data at a specified encryption level and offset.

methods.name: CopyCryptoDataToLocalBuffer
methods.description: Allocates buffer and copies crypto data into it.

methods.name: SplitCryptoFrame
methods.description: Splits crypto frames into multiple frames to represent the same data.

methods.name: AddPingFrames
methods.description: Adds random ping frames to frames list.

methods.name: SpreadPadding
methods.description: Adds padding frames randomly between other frames.

methods.name: BuildPacket
methods.description: Serializes frames into a packet buffer.
